notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (matches data.js fy 'Dec 2025'). Ownership comes from the 2026 proxy statement (accession 0000072971-26-000200), as of February 9, 2026. CHARLES SCHARF (Chairman, CEO and President; chairman since October 2025, per the 10-K's executive officer list): 1,118,702 shares; the proxy has no percentage column for individuals and states that none of them owns more than 1%, so pctEconomic is null. His unvested RSRs (590,782) and target PSAs (927,147) are not counted. HOLDERS: the percentages are as printed in the 2026 proxy, but each rests on a 13G/A as of December 2023 (Vanguard, BlackRock) or September 2024 (FMR); the percentages rose because the share count fell. DIVIDENDS are common-stock dividends only; Wells Fargo separately paid $1,050 million of preferred dividends (excluded). BUYBACKS are common-stock repurchases only; $2,000 million of preferred stock redemptions are excluded. GEOGRAPHY is null: Wells Fargo's segment note reports operating segments only and gives no revenue by geography. XBRL: the stock-comp figure is tagged us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensation (the cash-flow add-back, also $1,476 million), which equals the note total.
